    Proposition 5.4: successive correction of irreducible representatives #

    mesh-deformations.tex. Let C = kQ/(r_1, …, r_t) be a finite-dimensional graded category with homogeneous quadratic relations such that the derivatives D_{q-1} are surjective for q ≥ 3, and let E be a finite filtered category with a graded identification gr E = C. Choose lifts of the arrows; their relation errors lie in F³E. If the errors vanish in degrees below q, their degree-q classes lie in the image of D_{q-1}, and a parallel change of the arrows in degree q - 1 cancels them; a term using two corrections has degree at least 2q - 2 > q. The filtration is finite, so the process ends, and the resulting homomorphism C → E is an isomorphism.

    This file proves the proposition in the case used by the manuscript (Corollary 5.5): E = ind(mod A) filtered by the powers of its radical, C = k(Γ_A) = C(Γ_A, c), and the identification of Proposition 2.6(3). The surjectivity of the derivatives is a hypothesis (ScalarMeshCategory.MeshDerivativeSurjective), supplied outside characteristic two by Proposition 5.3.

    This file: lift families and their realizations.
